# F1 cluster capture

A snapshot of the e2e fixture cluster, for golden suites that test what the portal makes of
real operator output. Generated by `task e2e:up` then `task e2e:capture`; do not edit by hand.
`meta.yaml` names the versions it was taken with.

| File | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `meta.yaml` | capture time, kind and node image, CLI and operator versions, the subscribed catalog, and the `Ready` verdict of every instance, package and registration |
| `platforms.yaml`, `moduleinstances.yaml`, `modulepackages.yaml`, `transformerregistrations.yaml` | the four OPM kinds |
| `objects.yaml` | every object an inventory names, plus the ReplicaSets and Pods labelled `module-instance.opmodel.dev/name` |
| `events.yaml` | `events.k8s.io/v1` events in `default`, `cert-manager`, `pkg` and `web`, without events about Nodes |

Each file is a `kind: List` sorted by kind, namespace and name. Removed from every object:
`metadata.managedFields` and the `kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration` annotation;
from every ModuleInstance and ModulePackage: `spec.values`; from every CustomResourceDefinition:
`spec.versions[].schema`. No Secret is read. `task e2e:capture:check` enforces all of it on
every file under `testdata/clusters/`.

## This capture

Taken 2026-10-04 on podman kind (Kubernetes v1.36.1) with opm CLI v1.0.0-beta.7 and opm-operator
v1.0.0-beta.6 (`OPM_OPERATOR_VERSION`). The Platform is applied by `up.sh`, pinned to
`opmodel.dev/catalogs/opm@v4` 4.6.0 (`OPM_CATALOG_VERSION`); the accepted claim adds
`testing.opmodel.dev/catalogs/operator/backup@v0` 0.1.0 to its registry.

| Fixture | State |
| --- | --- |
| `cert-manager/cert-manager` | `Ready=True`, applied under a cluster-admin applier ServiceAccount |
| `default/podinfo` | `Ready=True`, two replicas |
| `pkg/podinfo` (ModulePackage) | `Ready=False/SourceNotReady`: no Flux on the cluster |
| `default/backup-provider` | `Ready=True`; it rendered the claim `default.backup-provider` |
| `default.backup-provider` (claim) | `Ready=True/Accepted`, accepted and active |
| `default/backup-consumer` | `Ready=True`: the claim's catalog implements the backup trait |
| `web/web` | CLI-owned, `Ready=Unknown/ManagedExternally`, two inventory objects |

Images: nginx in `web/web` is pinned by digest. cert-manager's three images (`v1.21.0`) and the
podinfo test module's image are pinned by tag only, since their modules set them; each Pod's
`status.containerStatuses[].imageID` records the digest that ran.

An operator built on a library older than v1.0.0-beta.2 (operator v1.0.0-beta.5 and earlier,
the one CLI v1.0.0-beta.7 embeds) refuses the claim `Ready=False/CatalogUnresolved`, and the
consumer then stays `Ready=False/ResolutionFailed`; this capture does not hold that state.
